description: This Swift source file defines an enum 'OpenClawNodeStorage' with static methods for constructing file URLs within specific directories such as application support, caches, and session-based subdirectories for Canvas and Snapshots.

methods.name: appSupportDir
methods.description: Returns the URL to the application's support directory, throwing an error if unavailable.

methods.name: canvasRoot
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a session-specific canvas directory within the application support directory, using the provided session key.

methods.name: cachesDir
methods.description: Returns the URL to the caches directory, throwing an error if unavailable.

methods.name: canvasSnapshotsRoot
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a session-specific canvas snapshots directory within the caches directory, using the provided session key.
